item.title: BONFOR Symposium & Promotionsbörse in Bonn
item.description: David represented our group at the BONFOR Symposium 2026 in Bonn, taking part in the Promotionsbörse (doctoral thesis fair) organized by the Medical Student Council alongside the symposium at the BMZ I. We have presented the work of the Computational Medical Imaging Research group (Albarqouni AG) at the Clinic for Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology and shared what doing a doctoral thesis with us looks like. It is a great opportunity to connect with the medical students looking for a thesis topic, walk them through our research directions in medical imaging and machine learning, and address their questions about getting started in research.

item.title: Contributed to the 23rd BONFOR Symposium in Bonn, Germany
item.description: At the 23rd BONFOR Symposium on Wednesday, 7 May 2025, held in the DZNE Lecture Hall at University Hospital Bonn, Albarqouni Lab actively showcased its current research by delivering concise oral presentations during the afternoon’s Doctoral Promotion Fair. Our team highlighted a diverse portfolio of projects—ranging from advanced image‐analysis pipelines to AI-driven diagnostic tools—and outlined potential MD-thesis topics for interested students, fostering in-depth discussions about methodological approaches and future research directions. By engaging directly with medical students, the lab not only raised awareness of its work but also provided guidance on how to embark on cutting-edge thesis projects within our group, thereby strengthening the pipeline of young clinician-scientists
